text: You just got lost in the woods with no food and no water.
Water is the big one. Most people only last about three days without it.
Your kidneys can't flush out the waste, your blood pressure drops, and your organs start to shut down.
But you find a stream. Now the clock is food.
In the first day, your body burns through its sugar and switches to burning fat.
After that, it starts eating your own muscle for fuel, and you get weaker every day.
With water, most people can last a few weeks, up to about two months.
Tag the friend who says they're starving every hour, and subscribe.
